    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6f34b894",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Get_halogen_bonds)=\n",
    "# get_halogen_bonds\n",
    "\n",
    "*Calculating sparse directional halogen-bond observations.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The experimental detector returns an independent `Interactions` analysis. Its descriptive method is `distance_two_angles`, with profile `smarts_donor_acceptor`. The ProLIF 2.2.2 geometric core adapts Auffinger et al. (2004); it is not the original paper's element-specific distance rule.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "See {func}`molsysmt.interactions.halogen_bonds.get_halogen_bonds` for arguments, errors and returned data.\n",
    ":::"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "331a5d85",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's show how this function works with three controlled structures containing a halogen donor and carbonyl acceptor. The middle structure is deliberately outside the cutoff. These synthetic coordinates illustrate the criterion and do not represent an optimized molecular geometry."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "ff779a01",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:19.709861Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:13:19.709396Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:13:20.210638Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:20.209316Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "949c3643",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:20.214776Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:13:20.214486Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.011259Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.009969Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from rdkit import Chem\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from molsysmt import pyunitwizard as puw\n",
    "\n",
    "molsys = msm.convert(Chem.MolFromSmiles('CCl.C=O'), to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "xyz = np.array([[-.15, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [.36, .12*np.sqrt(.75), 0], [.30, 0, 0]])\n",
    "coordinates = np.repeat(xyz[None], 3, axis=0)\n",
    "coordinates[1, [2, 3]] += [0, .5, 0]\n",
    "molsys.structures.append(coordinates=puw.quantity(coordinates, 'nm'))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "917dc02c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.014345Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.014060Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.388048Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.386972Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[0 2]\n",
      "('donor', 'halogen', 'acceptor', 'acceptor_reference')\n",
      "0\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "analysis = msm.interactions.halogen_bonds.get_halogen_bonds(molsys, pbc=False)\n",
    "print(analysis.occurrence_structures)\n",
    "print(analysis.participant_roles)\n",
    "print(analysis.query(structure_indices=[1]).n_interactions)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a981fa13",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Understanding distance and orientation\n",
    "\n",
    "For D–X···A–R, D is the atom bonded to halogen X, A is the acceptor and R is its reference neighbor. The inclusive defaults are X–A ≤ 0.35 nm, D–X–A between 130° and 180°, and X–A–R between 80° and 140°. Each eligible R defines a distinct relation. Undefined angles are skipped. Exact boundaries may differ from the angstrom reference through floating-point rounding; no geometric tolerance is added."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "537ac899",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.391086Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:13:24.390903Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.057887Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.056561Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x300 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3))\n",
    "axes[0].scatter(analysis.occurrence_structures, analysis.measurements['distance'])\n",
    "axes[0].axhline(.35, color='gray', linestyle='--')\n",
    "axes[0].set(xlabel='Structure index', ylabel='X–A distance (nm)', ylim=(0, .4))\n",
    "axes[1].scatter(analysis.occurrence_structures, np.rad2deg(analysis.measurements['acceptor_angle']))\n",
    "axes[1].axhspan(80, 140, alpha=.15)\n",
    "axes[1].set(xlabel='Structure index', ylabel='X–A–R angle (degrees)', ylim=(0, 180))\n",
    "fig.tight_layout()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "a28eef59",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Selecting structures and participating atoms\n",
    "\n",
    "Repeated structure indices are evaluated once. All four roles count: `internal` requires every participant, `incident` any participant, and `between` all participants inside two disjoint selections with at least one in each."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "a7fd0854",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.060547Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.060172Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.239530Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.238059Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "internal 0 [0 2]\n",
      "incident 2 [0 2]\n",
      "between 2 [0 2]\n",
      "Reference atom participates: 2\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "for mode, first, second in [('internal', [1, 3], None), ('incident', [2], None), ('between', [0, 1], [2, 3])]:\n",
    "    scoped = msm.interactions.halogen_bonds.get_halogen_bonds(\n",
    "        molsys, selection=first, selection_2=second, selection_mode=mode,\n",
    "        structure_indices=[2, 0, 2], pbc=False)\n",
    "    print(mode, scoped.n_interactions, scoped.evaluated_structure_indices)\n",
    "print('Reference atom participates:', analysis.query(atom_indices=[2], mode='involving_selection').n_interactions)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "291dd51b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Choosing units and output representation\n",
    "\n",
    "Thresholds accept unitful quantities or length strings. Angular intervals contain two unitful values. Output measurement columns use explicit `nm` and `radians` regardless of the configured display-unit policy. Typed output carries all coverage, chemistry, evidence and producer metadata."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "f8888014",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.242805Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.242597Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.316143Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.315151Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "{'distance': 'nm', 'donor_angle': 'radians', 'acceptor_angle': 'radians', 'donor_halogen_distance': 'nm', 'acceptor_reference_distance': 'nm'}\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "with puw.context(standard_units=['angstrom', 'degrees', 'ps', 'e']):\n",
    "    typed = msm.interactions.halogen_bonds.get_halogen_bonds(\n",
    "        molsys, distance_threshold='3.5 angstroms',\n",
    "        donor_angle_range=puw.quantity([130, 180], 'degrees'),\n",
    "        acceptor_angle_range=puw.quantity([80, 140], 'degrees'),\n",
    "        output_type='molsysmt.InteractionsDict', pbc=False)\n",
    "restored = msm.convert(typed, to_form='molsysmt.Interactions')\n",
    "print(restored.measure_units)\n",
    "assert restored.n_interactions == analysis.n_interactions"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "cb5e51d4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Reconstructing the periodic observation\n",
    "\n",
    "With a valid box, consecutive D–X, X–A and A–R MIC vectors define one coherent observed chain anchored on D. A stored integer image adds `image_vector @ box` to its participant coordinate. This extension is not complete molecule unwrapping or ring closure."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "c4ec815e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.318284Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.318093Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.416649Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.415593Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[[ 0  0  0]\n",
      " [ 1  0  0]\n",
      " [ 1 -1  0]\n",
      " [ 2 -1  0]]\n",
      "Observed X–A distance: 0.30000000000000004\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "periodic = msm.extract(molsys, structure_indices=[0])\n",
    "box = np.eye(3)\n",
    "lattice = np.array([[1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [-1, 1, 0], [0, 1, 0]])\n",
    "periodic.structures.coordinates = puw.quantity(coordinates[:1] + lattice @ box, 'nm')\n",
    "periodic.structures.box = puw.quantity(box[None], 'nm')\n",
    "observations = msm.interactions.halogen_bonds.get_halogen_bonds(periodic)\n",
    "observed = puw.get_value(periodic.structures.coordinates, to_unit='nm')[0, observations.participant_atoms] + observations.image_vectors @ box\n",
    "print(observations.image_vectors)\n",
    "print('Observed X–A distance:', np.linalg.norm(observed[2] - observed[1]))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "71966bb9",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Separating chemical interpretation from geometry\n",
    "\n",
    "Use {func}`molsysmt.physchem.get_halogen_bond_sites` independently to inspect a halogenated ligand and peptide-fragment graph before proposing a geometry. Fluorine and positively charged acceptors are excluded by this profile. No attractive interaction energy or universal chemical accuracy is inferred."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "eb52c961",

   "outputs": [

      "Candidate acceptor/reference pairs: [[ 1  0]\n",
      " [ 1  2]\n",
      " [ 1  6]\n",

     ]

    "sites = msm.physchem.get_halogen_bond_sites(Chem.MolFromSmiles('Clc1ccccc1.CC(=O)NCC(=O)O'))\n",
    "print('Candidate donor pairs:', sites['donor_halogen_pairs'])\n",

   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2e4148a5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Working from files and recording the analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "Attach explicitly under a name. Native and numeric-index H5MSM inputs deliver projected coordinate blocks through `heavy_mode=\"auto\"` or `\"force\"`; rich file selections may require bounded eager loading. The complete chemical graph and accepted sparse output remain in memory. Match, candidate and result budgets raise explicitly; numerical estimates are not a process-RSS cap."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "48443e2f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.568105Z",

     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-06T17:13:25.898766Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[0 2]\n",
      "{'molsysmt': '0.22.4+24.g42b487869', 'rdkit': '2025.09.5'}\n",
      "['doi:10.1073/pnas.0407607101', 'doi:10.1186/s13321-021-00548-6', 'software:molsysmt:0.22.4+24.g42b487869', 'software:rdkit:2025.09.5']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:\n",
    "    path = str(Path(directory) / 'halogens.h5msm')\n",
    "    molsys.interactions = {**molsys.interactions, 'halogens': analysis}\n",
    "    msm.convert(molsys, to_form=path)\n",
    "    from_file = msm.interactions.halogen_bonds.get_halogen_bonds(path, structure_indices=[2, 0], pbc=False, heavy_mode='force')\n",
    "    loaded = msm.convert(path, to_form='molsysmt.MolSys')\n",
    "    assert loaded.interactions['halogens'].parameters == analysis.parameters\n",
    "    print(from_file.evaluated_structure_indices)\n",
    "print(analysis.software)\n",
    "print([item['id'] for item in analysis.parameters['attribution']['items']])"
   ]
  },
